title: Senior Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer - Splunk (Saudi Arabia)
teaser: Become part of our team as a Senior Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer, delivering advanced security operations solutions to enterprise clients in Saudi Arabia. Guide clients through security challenges, design integrated workflows, and mentor peers. Ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in cybersecurity pre-sales and solution architecture.
description:
Nature of the Work: Hybrid Full Time

Hours of work: 48 hours per week

Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.

Application start and end date: Starting July 30th for approx. 4-6 weeks
 

Meet the team

Splunk, a Cisco company, is building a resilient digital world with an end-to-end platform designed for hybrid, multi-cloud environments. We approach our work with kindness, valuing the unique talents, passion, and joy that each team member brings to our collaborative culture. Our team is dedicated to helping organizations reach their best by solving complex business challenges at scale. We foster an environment of inclusiveness, disruption, and fun, ensuring that every member feels supported as they reach new heights.
 

Your impact

As a Splunk Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the pre-sales process by partnering with our Sales team to deliver technical expertise on advanced security operations solutions. Operating as a senior individual contributor, you will guide enterprise clients in Saudi Arabia through security challenges, mapping their unique needs to integrated security workflows to ensure robust digital resilience.

You will balance technical excellence with a strategic attitude, laying the groundwork to evolve into a leadership capacity while driving our team strategy forward. Success in this role means effectively mentoring peers and designing tailored architectures that empower our rapidly growing customer base to achieve their business objectives securely. Ultimately, you will serve as a trusted domain expert, transforming security obstacles into scalable solutions that protect critical financial and enterprise infrastructures.
 

What you will do

Establish and proactively maintain positive relationships with clients and partners to drive mutual growth in the cybersecurity space.

Collaborate closely with account teams to align with sales strategies, providing comprehensive support through briefings, proposals, and issue resolution for SecOps portfolios.

Demonstrate Splunk Cybersecurity products and services onsite, remotely via webinars, and at field events to showcase platform value to prospective buyers.

Design and architect integrated security workflows tailored to enterprise and financial sector clients to meet their specific regulatory and operational requirements.

Execute Proof of Values (POVs) and technical integrations to validate solution effectiveness and secure technical wins.

Apply organized and analytical approaches to creatively overcome sales obstacles and accelerate the sales cycle.

Mentor junior team members by sharing domain expertise and driving team strategy to prepare for future leadership responsibilities.
 

Minimum qualifications

10+ years of experience in technical sales, pre-sales, or solution architecture within the cybersecurity sector.

Experience designing and implementing integrated security workflows within Security Operations (SecOps) environments.

Experience configuring and deploying enterprise cybersecurity platforms, such as Palo Alto Networks (CORTEX), Chronicle, Microsoft Defender, or Fortinet.

Experience conducting Proof of Value (POV) engagements and delivering technical product demonstrations for enterprise security solutions.

Experience working directly with enterprises in Saudi Arabia.
 

Preferred qualifications

Attainment of industry-recognized cybersecurity certifications, such as CISSP, SANS Cybersecurity, or vendor-specific credentials (e.g., Palo Alto, Microsoft).

Experience mentoring technical teams and leading strategic pre-sales initiatives.

Experience working with modern application architectures, including Kubernetes, Docker, or serverless technologies.

Proficiency in modern programming languages, such as Python, Java, or Go.

Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and concepts, including LLMs or GenAI frameworks, as they apply to security analytics.

Understanding of digital resilience strategies and how security solutions integrate to support overall business continuity.

Exceptional communication and presentation skills to effectively translate complex technical concepts to diverse business and technical audiences.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
